display_long_description:
Step into the criminal underworld in the definitive tactile VR crime scene cleaner simulator on Meta Quest. When the mob leaves behind a bloody aftermath, you are the specialist sent in to sanitize the room. Bag forensic evidence, scrub bloodstained surfaces, dispose of bodies, and erase every trace before sirens echo outside.

[media]
[media]

TACTILE VR CLEANUP & PHYSICS

Manual Disposal & Heavy Physics: Drag heavy corpses, zip body bags with your own hands, load incinerators, and chemically dissolve biological remains. Every object reacts with 1:1 physical weight—no button shortcuts.

Forensic Tools & UV Scanners: Wield specialized UV blacklights, chemical sprays, and black-market detectors to uncover microscopic blood splatter, hidden shell casings, and wiped fingerprints across walls and floors.

Evidence Destruction & Sanitization: Scrub bloodstains using realistic pressure and motion. Pack murder weapons, dissolve illicit contraband in acid baths, and sanitize entire crime scenes to pass strict police forensic sweeps.

High-Stakes Countdown & Stealth Pressure: Sirens draw closer and suspicious neighbors linger outside. Manage your time, maintain stealth, and work under intense psychological pressure where one overlooked droplet means prison.

Comfort-Focused Gameplay: Designed from the ground up for seated, standing, or room-scale setups. Smooth, natural physical interactions provide deep immersion with zero motion sickness.

They make the mess. You erase the evidence.
